description: Read the commerce audit trail for your workspace: what the pipeline drafted, approved, rejected and executed. This is the commerce trail, separate from list_audit_events. Filter by subject_kind and subject_id, for example proposal and a proposal id. Needs a Last Price credential with commerce catalog read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

limit.description: Most rows to return. Defaults to 100.

subject_id.description: Only events about this subject id.

subject_kind.description: Only events about this kind of subject, e.g. proposal.

name: list_commerce_audit_events
